defect_title: Rafter Lateral-Torsional Buckling Moment Gradient Factor
audit_finding_1_5_3_2b1: Phase 1.5.3.2B cited IS 800 Table 42 for C1 = 1.75 which strictly applies to linear end-moment gradients with psi = 0 and zero transverse loads. A simply supported rafter under net uplift UDL has a parabolic moment profile.
root_cause: Omission of transverse distributed load variation and reliance on linear end-moment gradient factor without quarter-point integration.
code_changes_implemented: Updated evaluate_wind_uplift_rafter_flexure() in structural/workflows/system_a_final.py. Implemented rational quarter-point parabolic moment gradient Cb = 1.2987 ~ 1.30 (Md = 90.40 kNm UR = 0.447 <= 1.0). Retained uniform lower bound C1 = 1.0 (Md = 75.74 kNm UR = 0.534 <= 1.0) and full-span failure (UR = 1.089 > 1.0).
independent_verification_method: Test 02 in tests/test_phase1_5_3_2_system_a_final.py incorporates an independent first-principles quarter-point solver yielding Cb = 1.2987 Md = 90.40 kNm and asserts full-span unbraced rafter fails LTB.
governing_code_citation: IS 800:2007 Cl 8.2.2.1 / Annex E Eq 1 / AISC 360-16 Eq F1-1 / Kirby-Nethercot (1979)

defect_title: Fly-Bracing Restraint System Complete Stiffness & Detail Modeling
audit_finding_1_5_3_2b1: Phase 1.5.3.2B cited IS 800 Cl 8.9.2 (which pertains to web stiffeners not lateral bracing) and checked only the diagonal strut axial stiffness (64.75 kN/mm) while ignoring cleat flexure bolt contact and purlin web out-of-plane flexibility.
root_cause: Misattribution of code clause and omission of series-spring flexibility components in the restraint load path.
code_changes_implemented: Updated design_bottom_flange_fly_bracing() in structural/workflows/system_a_final.py. Corrected citation to IS 800:2007 Cl 8.3.2 (2.5% compression flange force rule Pbr = 3.514 kN) and Winter-Yura criterion (K_req = 4*Nc/Lb = 0.1234 kN/mm). Implemented complete series spring model (K_strut=64.75 K_cleat=17.30 K_bolt=50.0 -> K_sys=10.72 kN/mm -> 86.9x required). Modeled purlin web flexibility (0.650 kN/mm without cleat) and single-leg angle eccentricity (IR = 0.224).
independent_verification_method: Test 04 in tests/test_phase1_5_3_2_system_a_final.py contains independent test-side solvers for series stiffness single-leg interaction and bolt bearing.
governing_code_citation: IS 800:2007 Cl 8.3.2 & Cl 7.5.1 / Cl 9.3 & Winter-Yura (1996) Stability Criterion

defect_title: Parametric Baseplate Fillet Weld Numerical Integration
audit_finding_1_5_3_2b1: Phase 1.5.3.2B utilized hardcoded weld group section modulus Zw = 450067 mm3 without parametric integration and only checked gravity loading ignoring net uplift load reversal.
root_cause: Hardcoding derived cross-sectional geometry constants and evaluating only one directional load case.
code_changes_implemented: Implemented WeldSegment ParametricWeldGroupProperties and ParametricWeldGroupSolver in structural/workflows/system_a_final.py. Evaluates exact numerical integration of ISMB 300 contour (12 segments Aw = 4809.0 mm2 Zw = 442888.5 mm3). Evaluates both gravity (fe = 18.14 MPa UR = 0.096 <= 1.0) and net uplift reversal (fe = 14.96 MPa UR = 0.079 <= 1.0).
independent_verification_method: Test 09 and Test 14 in tests/test_phase1_5_3_2_system_a_final.py implement independent numerical integration of weld group and test asymmetric geometry.
governing_code_citation: IS 800:2007 Cl 10.5.10.1.1 (Combined Normal and Shear Stresses in Fillet Welds)

defect_title: Product-Specific Adhesive Anchor & Host Slab Clearance Model
audit_finding_1_5_3_2b1: Phase 1.5.3.2B used generic concrete breakout capacity (66.35 kN) and failed to evaluate anchor product specifications manufacturer approval criteria or physical embedment feasibility in thin slabs.
root_cause: Generic anchor assumptions without manufacturer ETA verification and lack of minimum slab thickness (h_min) clearance checking.
code_changes_implemented: Implemented ProductSpecificChemicalAnchorModel in structural/workflows/system_a_final.py for Hilti HIT-RE 500 V4 / HAS-U M16 Gr 8.8 under ETA-20/0541 and EN 1992-4. Formally flags hef = 125 mm as physically infeasible in 125-150 mm slab (h_min = 161 mm). Implemented 3 engineering alternatives (hef = 80 mm through-bolting cast plinths). Integrated host slab punching shear with unbalanced moment per IS 456 Cl 31.6.2 (tau_v = 0.3039 MPa UR = 0.272).
independent_verification_method: Test 08 Test 09 and Test 14 in tests/test_phase1_5_3_2_system_a_final.py independently solve all 6 anchor failure modes slab clearance and punching shear.

defect_title: Test Isolation Hardening & Active Connection Interception
audit_finding_1_5_3_2b1: Phase 1.5.3.2B relied on passive path redirection; no active trap prevented a test from executing direct sqlite3.connect calls against production databases.
root_cause: Absence of active runtime interception on standard database connection libraries.
code_changes_implemented: Updated tests/test_isolation_helper.py to introduce ConnectionAuditor which wraps sqlite3.connect during IsolatedTestEnvironment activation. Actively traps every connection attempt logs paths and immediately raises RuntimeError if any blocked production path is targeted.
independent_verification_method: Test 15 in tests/test_phase1_5_3_2_system_a_final.py actively attempts to connect to PROD_STRUCTURAL_DB and PROD_QUOTATIONS_DB asserting that RuntimeError is raised and logged. Pre- and post-test SHA-256 hashes confirm zero mutation.
governing_code_citation: Python Standard Library sqlite3 Monkeypatching & Hermetic Sandboxing Architecture

defect_title: Independent Test Solvers & First-Principles Quality Verification
audit_finding_1_5_3_2b1: Phase 1.5.3.2B test assertions in Tests 05 and 09 used static hardcoded numbers rather than computing capacities from independent first principles within test methods.
root_cause: Duplication of production constants into test assert statements without independent derivation.
code_changes_implemented: Refactored all tests in tests/test_phase1_5_3_2_system_a_final.py (Tests 01 02 03 04 05 09 14 15). Every capacity demand and interaction ratio is derived via test-side closed-form or numerical algorithms before assertion against production workflows.
independent_verification_method: Tests 01-15 execute 100% independent calculations comparing workflow outputs to first-principles physics. Added negative and boundary tests.
governing_code_citation: ASME V&V 10 / IEEE 1012-2016 Software Verification Standards
